name: chat-viewer help
description: Help mode entries for plugin:chat-viewer. Drafts (draft: true) were written from the code by framework/cli/help-coverage.mjs --draft; edit them into plain English and drop the draft flag.
author: AmberX AXF

entries.title: Chat viewer
entries.text: Its settings: where sessions come from, voices, how often it checks.

entries.title: Check for updates
entries.text: Looks for new sessions now instead of waiting.

entries.title: Import export
entries.text: Imports export. Part of Chat viewer.

entries.title: Mark all read
entries.text: Clears the unread marks on every session.

entries.title: Back to every session
entries.text: Back to the list.

entries.title: Copy the transcript
entries.text: Copies the whole session as text.

entries.title: Export as Markdown
entries.text: Saves the session as a Markdown file.

entries.title: Export as text
entries.text: Saves the session as a plain text file.

entries.title: Audio
entries.text: Turn the session into audio: you and Amber in two voices.

entries.title: Tool calls
entries.text: Shows or hides the tool calls between the messages.

entries.title: Voices from
entries.text: Where you set “Voices from”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Chat viewer.

entries.title: Brett's voice
entries.text: Where you set “Brett's voice”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Chat viewer.

entries.title: From message

entries.title: To message
entries.text: Where you set “To message”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Chat viewer.

entries.title: Set up free voices
entries.text: Installs the free Piper voices on the server so audio costs nothing.

entries.title: Make audio
entries.text: Reads the session out loud into an audio file, one voice for you, one for Amber.

entries.title: Delete this audio
entries.text: Deletes the audio file. The session stays.

entries.title: Load player
entries.text: Loads the audio so you can play it here.

entries.title: Check every (minutes, 0 = only on load)
entries.text: Where you set “Check every (minutes, 0 = only on load)”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Chat viewer.

entries.title: Claude Code session folders (one per line: path | label)
entries.text: Where you set “Claude Code session folders (one per line: path | label)”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Chat viewer.

entries.title: Headless build logs (one glob per line)
entries.text: Where you set “Headless build logs (one glob per line)”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Chat viewer.

entries.title: Hub drop folder (empty = the hub's sessions/claude-ai)
entries.text: Where you set “Hub drop folder (empty = the hub's sessions/claude-ai)”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Chat viewer.

entries.title: Save sources
entries.text: Saves where sessions are read from.

entries.title: Back to defaults
